headline: M2: historical evidence materialized for all 100 cases.
detail: Historical-context evidence is now materialized and integrity-validated for the full 100-observation suitable benchmark pool. The private evidence library contains 820 unique historical context records supporting 1,952 case-to-context relationships; all 820 evidence hashes passed, two legacy non-UTF-8 records were preserved byte-for-byte, all 100 cases are ready for human context-sufficiency review, and relationship ground truth remains unassigned. M2 now advances to the Excel-native context-sufficiency review gate.
next_gate: Complete the Excel-native 100-case human context-sufficiency review. Cases marked MORE_CONTEXT_REQUIRED receive bounded retrieval expansion; cases marked SUFFICIENT_FOR_ADJUDICATION proceed to relationship ground-truth adjudication.
public_private_boundary: Only aggregate research-progress counts are public. Private evidence packets, historical-context evidence, raw operational records, and case-level decisions are not exposed by this status artifact.
